description: Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital dual role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our clinical team is well-trained and our environment remains safe for all residents and staff.In this position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control efforts, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff on best practices to maintain a healthy and compliant facility. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 for this essential role.If you are a proactive and experienced Registered Nurse with a passion for both education and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply and make a significant impact on our facility's quality of care.
requirements: Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
